# Any scope. Increment sent event counter safely.
oe_bem_inc_sent = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_bem_sent_cnt } change_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_sent_cnt add = 1 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_sent_cnt value = 1 } }
}

# Any scope. Clamped counter helpers (0..100).
oe_bem_add_synod_tension = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_bem_synod_tension } change_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_synod_tension add = $amt$ } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_synod_tension value = $amt$ } }
    clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_synod_tension min = 0 max = 100 }
}

oe_bem_add_wrath = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_bem_aristocrat_wrath } change_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_aristocrat_wrath add = $amt$ } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_aristocrat_wrath value = $amt$ } }
    clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_aristocrat_wrath min = 0 max = 100 }
}

oe_bem_add_rev_pressure = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_bem_rev_pressure } change_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_rev_pressure add = $amt$ } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_rev_pressure value = $amt$ } }
    clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_rev_pressure min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# Country scope. Apply opinion modifier to an extant tag distinct from root.
oe_bem_opn_tag = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:$tag$ NOT = { this = c:$tag$ } }
        c:$tag$ = { add_opinion = { modifier = $mod$ target = root } }
    }
}

# Country scope. Advance a spawned institution in core imperial cities (with explicit has_owner = yes guard!).
oe_bem_push_inst = {
    if = {
        limit = { institution:$inst$ = { has_spawned = yes } }
        if = {
            limit = { location:constantinople = { has_owner = yes owner = root NOT = { has_institution = institution:$inst$ } } }
            location:constantinople = { change_institution_progress = { type = institution:$inst$ value = $val$ } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { location:thessaloniki = { has_owner = yes owner = root NOT = { has_institution = institution:$inst$ } } }
            location:thessaloniki = { change_institution_progress = { type = institution:$inst$ value = $val$ } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { location:athens = { has_owner = yes owner = root NOT = { has_institution = institution:$inst$ } } }
            location:athens = { change_institution_progress = { type = institution:$inst$ value = $val$ } }
        }
    }
}

# Any scope. Resolve live Eastern Roman host (prefer ROM over BYZ).
oe_bem_resolve_host = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:ROM c:ROM = { oe_bem_host_ready = yes } }
        c:ROM = { save_scope_as = oe_bem_tmp_host }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_host value = scope:oe_bem_tmp_host }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { oe_bem_host_ready = yes } }
        c:BYZ = { save_scope_as = oe_bem_tmp_host }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_host value = scope:oe_bem_tmp_host }
    }
    else = {
        remove_global_variable = oe_bem_host
    }
}

# Any scope. One-time initialization of the Byzantine/Roman Early Modern Modernization line.
oe_bem_init_line = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_init value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_end value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_sent_cnt value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_synod_tension value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_aristocrat_wrath value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_rev_pressure value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_rel_policy value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_mil_reform value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_code_type value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_regime_choice value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_endgame value = 0 }
    oe_bem_resolve_host = yes
    if = {
        limit = { oe_bem_has_host = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_on value = 1 }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_end value = 8 }
    }
}

# Public monthly entry point for reserved scheduler Slot 57 (gen_mainline_lock.py: bem1).
# Covers Act 1 (1560-1648 Confessional Era) & Act 2 (1648-1740 Absolutism & Line-Theme Reform).
# Deduplicated per calendar month via oe_bem_ran_m.
oe_bem_act12_monthly = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_m value = oe_bem_m_now }
    if = {
        limit = {
            current_year >= 1560
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_bem_act2_done }
            NOT = { global_var:oe_bem_ran_m ?= global_var:oe_bem_m }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_ran_m value = global_var:oe_bem_m }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_bem_init } }
            oe_bem_init_line = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_bem_end ?= 8 current_year <= 1758 }
            oe_bem_resolve_host = yes
            if = {
                limit = { oe_bem_has_host = yes }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_end value = 0 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_on value = 1 }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_bem_on }
            if = {
                limit = { current_year > 1758 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_act2_done value = 1 }
            }
            else = {
                oe_bem_resolve_host = yes
                if = {
                    limit = { oe_bem_has_host = yes }
                    oe_bem_dispatch_act12 = yes
                }
                else = {
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_end value = 8 }
                    remove_global_variable = oe_bem_on
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Public monthly entry point for reserved scheduler Slot 58 (gen_mainline_lock.py: bem2).
# Covers Act 2 finale handoff & Act 3 (1737-1836 Purple Enlightenment & Revolutionary Reckoning).
# Deduplicated per calendar month via oe_bem_ran_m_3.
oe_bem_act3_monthly = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_m value = oe_bem_m_now }
    if = {
        limit = {
            current_year >= 1730
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_bem_done }
            NOT = { global_var:oe_bem_ran_m_3 ?= global_var:oe_bem_m }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_ran_m_3 value = global_var:oe_bem_m }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_bem_init } }
            oe_bem_init_line = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_bem_end ?= 8 current_year <= 1835 }
            oe_bem_resolve_host = yes
            if = {
                limit = { oe_bem_has_host = yes }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_end value = 0 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_on value = 1 }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_bem_on }
            if = {
                limit = { current_year > 1835 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_done value = 1 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_end value = 3 }
                remove_global_variable = oe_bem_on
            }
            else = {
                oe_bem_resolve_host = yes
                if = {
                    limit = { oe_bem_has_host = yes }
                    oe_bem_dispatch_act3 = yes
                }
                else = {
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_end value = 8 }
                    remove_global_variable = oe_bem_on
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# TEST ONLY: simulate magnate wrath spike (+65) and optional SIT-3 outcome awareness for isolated QA.
oe_bem_test_wrath = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_bem_on } } oe_bem_test_start = yes }
    oe_bem_add_wrath = { amt = 65 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_bem_fired_5 value = 1 }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_twe_outcome } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_twe_outcome value = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_twe_old_order_shaken } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_twe_old_order_shaken value = 0 }
    }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_bem.90
}
